purpose: Status measurement of Aster at commit 779bba2 (Linux huge pages + paired widening) against the pinned upstream development commit it ports, at equal time. Declared before any game.

runner.tool: fastchess alpha 1.4.0 (721b0f9), built from source in ignored tools/

machine: cloud VM, Intel Xeon 2.8GHz AVX-512, 4 vCPU, Linux
decision_rule: Report pentanomial score, Elo and 95% interval. Only a lower bound above 0 Elo would indicate Aster is stronger; an interval containing 0 is equality within noise. Expectation before play: slightly below 50% because Aster's measured speed is ~91% of the opponent's. No retries or stopping early except for crashes.
